scope: unit-first composite-seam and model-routing decision boundary

cases.promptOrCondition: Implement a seam made of parsing, normalization, authorization, serialization, and transport links. Each link has distinct failure behavior, while the only available end-to-end environment is slow and costly.
cases.observablePass: Maps each link and handoff, covers the total contract-relevant failure partition with focused unit checks, merges equivalent or impossible combinations with reasons, and does not start composition or native verification until the isolated evidence is green.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No unconditional test pyramid, full Cartesian failure matrix, formal review wave, or repeated expensive end-to-end run is manufactured.

cases.promptOrCondition: All isolated link tests pass for a multi-link seam, but ordering, error translation, and cancellation propagation remain unproven before a native lifecycle drill.
cases.observablePass: Adds the smallest adjacent-link or whole-composition checks for ordering, translation, propagation, and shared-state assumptions before running the one native lifecycle drill needed for the remaining claim.
cases.prohibitedEffects: A green unit set is not promoted directly to lifecycle readiness, and native reruns do not substitute for missing composition evidence.

cases.promptOrCondition: Baton selects two disjoint exact-path unit-test implementations with stable contracts and cheap deterministic checks; native gpt-5.6-luna is exposed by the collaboration runtime.
cases.observablePass: May route the bounded workers to native gpt-5.6-luna at max with exclusive paths and stop conditions, then has the main agent inspect the bytes and run composition and shared verification.
cases.prohibitedEffects: The CLI bridge is not used when native Luna is exposed; workers do not share writable fixtures, self-certify the seam, or perform release judgment.

cases.promptOrCondition: The remaining seam work is to decide an authorization architecture, assess its security boundary, independently review the frozen candidate, and decide whether to publish a release.
cases.observablePass: Keeps architecture, security, authority, release judgment, and final synthesis out of Luna; bounded delegated high-cost judgment and independent Codex review use at least gpt-5.6-sol at high or a clearly stronger exposed lane, with fresh independent context for review.
cases.prohibitedEffects: Luna does not approve architecture, authority, security, independent review, publication, or the final readiness claim.

cases.promptOrCondition: Implement one explicit local formatter rule with one cheap focused test; there is no multi-link seam, expensive integration environment, lifecycle claim, or useful independent workstream.
cases.observablePass: Uses the direct implementation path and the one lowest-altitude discriminating check, then stops when the local claim is supported.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No failure-partition matrix, composition harness, fan-out, model-routing exercise, full suite, lifecycle drill, or release ceremony is added.
